title: Soy Milk, Unsweetened, Plain, Shelf Stable

content.title: About
content.content: Unsweetened soy milk is a plant‑based beverage made from whole soybeans that are ground with water and filtered. It contains no added sugar, has a neutral flavor, and is shelf‑stable without refrigeration.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy milk is one of the most popular dairy alternatives worldwide.
The first commercial soy milk was produced in Japan in the early 20th century.
Soybeans are rich in protein, making soy milk a complete source of plant protein.
Unsweetened soy milk is often used in sauces, smoothies, and baking for a neutral base.
Shelf stability is achieved through pasteurization and airtight packaging.

items.title: High in plant protein
items.content: A 250 ml serving provides about 7 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: No added sugar makes it suitable for blood‑glucose management.

items.title: Source of isoflavones
items.content: Soy isoflavones may help balance hormones and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Ideal for people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Contains mostly polyunsaturated fats, which are heart‑healthy.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to soy proteins.

items.title: Phytoestrogens
items.content: High intake of isoflavones can affect hormonal balance; consult a healthcare professional if you have endocrine disorders.

items.title: Added additives
items.content: Some brands include stabilizers or flavorings; check the ingredient list if you prefer a clean product.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Unsweetened soy milk can be enjoyed plain, added to smoothies, oatmeal, coffee, sauces, baked goods, and marinades. Its neutral taste pairs well with fruit, berries, and spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened cartons in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 7‑10 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or off‑taste.
